structured.answer: No. I wouldn't trust this page to choose where to invest. It's full of English, unfamiliar terms and minus signs, and it's from a site called "מקור" that I don't know. I'll ask my son, or ask at the bank, about the numbers it shows for what banks charge.

stuck.why: "להשקיע במדד". To me מדד is the price index on the news, so I didn't understand what this was about
"−43 ₪ לעומת הבחירה שלכם". A minus sign made me back away without knowing what it meant
I wasn't sure whether 6,576 ₪ under הפועלים is what the bank takes from me or something else
Long list of minus numbers and English fund names, too many numbers, I got anxious and stopped

used: Heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד"
"פסגות" marked "הזול" at top of the right list
Bank names with numbers: לאומי, הפועלים, דיסקונט, מזרחי טפחות
skimmed: Sliders and input boxes for amount, monthly deposit, years, return
Coloured tag labels under each fund
Left column of fund names with codes
skipped: The coloured cost bar and legend on screen 2
Grey line with dollar rate and inflation
Fold-out arrows next to banks ("לא בחישוב")
unsure_meaning: תעודת סל, קרן מחקה, קרן סל
מס גם על שינוי המטבע, חשיפה לדולר
Minus numbers like −43, −447, −3,671: loss or difference?
not_found: Anything about deposits or safe saving
A plain sentence saying what my bank takes from me
Who is behind the site, whether it is official
would_change: Start with a plain sentence: how much your bank takes vs. the cheapest, in shekels
Explain מדד in this sense and avoid English letters
Don't show differences as minus numbers in a long list; say 'you would keep X less'
Fewer coloured tags; light background, larger text

findings.what: Minus numbers everywhere (−43, −447, −3,671, −4,492) look like losses and frighten
findings.where: Screens 1–4, left column and result boxes

findings.what: Opens with מדד, S&P, MSCI and sliders, so it doesn't feel like it's for me
Too many coloured tags and numbers on one screen
English fund names (iShares, Vanguard UCITS ETF) can't be read
Unclear whether the bank numbers (6,576, 10,608) are what the bank charges
Unknown site name "מקור", nothing showing it's official
Small grey text with the dollar rate is hard to read
Red bars without a sentence saying what they mean
